capabilities: Manage tasks, projects, and areas as one-file-per-item markdown
Show agenda by day or week with the daily or weekly note
Navigate tasks and tags in sidebar tabs with filters
Parse due dates, deadlines, and repeats from natural language
Log completed tasks and roll repeating tasks forward
extras: README includes an AI disclaimer stating Ta Da and its plugin are '100% vibe-coded.' The file format is documented externally in Ta Da's docs/file-format.md. Calendar events and reminders stay with the macOS/iOS apps, not the plugin, and files/settings are shared with the app via Ta Da/ in the vault. The iOS app is in beta.
intentEvidence: replicates most of the capabilities of the Ta Da app for macOS and iOS
problem: Obsidian's built-in tasks are checkbox lists inside notes, offering no one-task-per-file structure with projects, areas, an agenda, or natural-language scheduling.
